transcript.text: Now compute net revenue for East region (corrected focus region), completed orders, calendar year 2025 using orders joined with customers.

args.sql:
SELECT SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_revenue_cents, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE c.region = 'East'
  AND o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
